title: Make a product promo video from one line
summary: Developer liyupi's add-on has Claude Code research a product, take sharp screenshots, cut to the music's beat and add a voice; he shows five videos, each taking 4–18 minutes to finish.
agent_role: The agent researches the product, asks two rounds of questions, drafts 3-4 style frames, then captures screenshots, scores audio, edits, transcribes the narration to check it, and reviews the renders. The human confirms requirements, picks a style, logs in where needed and approves music and voices.
outcome: Author reports five promo videos made with the tool in distinct styles, each revised over real feedback rounds, with 60+ recorded pitfalls folded back into the rules. Final 4K renders take 4-18 minutes.
what_they_did: Developer liyupi wrote down his whole promo-video process as rules a coding agent can follow. He added a video-making template and helper scripts. You give Claude Code, Cursor or Codex a product name or web address. The agent researches it, asks two rounds of questions, sketches 3-4 looks, takes 4K screenshots, cuts to the beat and adds a generated voice. You confirm details, pick a look, log in where needed, and approve music and voices.
how_it_went: The author shows five promo videos made with the tool, each in a different style. Each was revised over real rounds of feedback. The lessons went back into the rules as 60+ recorded pitfalls. Final 4K videos take 4 to 18 minutes to produce.
worth_knowing: The video tool, Remotion, is free only for individuals and companies of up to 3 people; bigger teams need a paid license. The voice service ElevenLabs can't be used for business on its free plan, and making music to fit the video needs a paid plan.
prompt: Make a promo video for [product name or URL]. First research the product and list its key selling points with sources. Then ask me about aspect ratio, length, audience, style, opening and music, giving a recommended option for each. Propose 3-4 distinct style directions with one sample frame each, and wait for my choice. Capture real 4K screenshots of the product and ask me to log in if a page needs it. Cut the edit to the music's beats. If you add narration, transcribe it back and check that every brand name and URL is read correctly. Let me listen to the music and voice before you finalize, then render and review each scene before delivering.

curation.rationale: The README documents a detailed 10-stage agent workflow that researches a product, proposes styles, captures 4K screenshots, scores audio and self-checks renders, plus five real promo videos and their revision history. The +0.5 marketing boost applies.
